basic_info.description: Fabulous courtyard facing unit with views of a lush, landscaped garden. Knox is a popular building located on the border of Dogpatch and Potrero, walking distance to 22nd Caltrain Station and 3rd Street Muni. Features include a spacious open floorplan with contemporary finishes, high-end appliances, including a washer & dryer in unit. The impressive kitchen island finished with white quartz is ideal for those who enjoy cooking and entertaining. Large East facing windows allow plenty of natural light and splendid views of the luscious butterfly garden. Completed in 2017, this residence shows like a newly completed home with all the amenities of a luxury development. In addition, Knox unit 313 includes NEST air conditioning, a walk-in closet, 1 secure parking space, additional storage, plus bike storage. Building amenities include a Fitness Center, Media Center, Interior Courtyard with 3 firepits and BBQ Area, Bike Room, Package Room, Butterfly Mix Intercom System & Lobby Attendant.
